event.description: Reduce both feed-forward hidden widths from 48 to 44
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 6,080 parameters at 100.000000%, a +1.000000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There are 0 prior attempts in this family; consequently there is no most recent accepted result and no most recent failed result in-family. This is more informative than the nearest untested ff_dim=46 because the larger step gives a clearer initial capacity signal while remaining only an 8.3% FF-width reduction.
